messages:
maya: Heads-up — we hit a really odd TS overload/inference collapse when bundling for edge (esbuild). SDK has two overloads for request (stream vs non-stream) and after bundling our input type becomes `unknown`. Anyone seen this pattern?

trent: yep. Usually an issue with the bundler resolving the runtime entry but dropping the .d.ts semantics. Are you bundling the SDK into the output or marking it external?

maya: bundling it. We bundle to a single file for Cloudflare with esbuild. Local tsc shows correct types; only broken after bundle.

sam: esbuild often rewrites/strips type-only imports when you bundle compiled JS instead of preserving type imports. Quick check: does your bundle include any rewritten `exports` boilerplate around the SDK? That can indicate the d.ts didn't line up.

maya: yes there's a small helper near top that re-exports runtime symbols. I also noticed runtime signatures in node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/cjs... but dist/index.d.ts seems to have overloads ok. The problem is esbuild replacing imports with a shim that loses the type relationships.

trent: two approaches: 1) mark @redwood/inference external in esbuild so types resolve from node_modules at compile time (no code bundled), or 2) add a small ambient declaration in your app that narrows the overloads so TS picks the correct signature.

maya: externalizing works but increases runtime fetches (which is fine for us). As a stopgap I tried a local module augmentation to force the non-stream overload and it fixed compile. Not ideal though.

sam: we should also ask SDK to publish a dedicated ESM d.ts that doesn't re-export via `export =` or CJS shims — those patterns break edge/ESM consumers. Filing an SDK issue would help avoid more teams hitting this.

maya: opened issue #4529 on the SDK repo with a minimal repro and bundle snapshot. docbot: please create a ticket to externalize the SDK in our edge build until upstream fixes it.

docbot: Created INFRA ticket 802: "edge: externalize @redwood/inference in esbuild bundle until SDK types stabilized" - https://internal/INFRA-802

trent: also FYI, if you need a short-term DX fix in consumers, add `importsNotUsedAsValues: 'preserve'` in tsconfig and use `import type` for SDK types. That sometimes stops the bundler from collapsing contextual typing.

maya: thanks all — externalized for now and added a small compile-only test to catch regression. Will monitor SDK issue.
